known_assets: Map 1 uses the existing Wikimedia Commons wall/floor/stone materials.
Map 4 uses the existing warm stone re-grade.
Map 5 v27 bridge, edge body, abyss field, columns and signs are procedural world geometry.

rule: Map 5 occlusion is deliberate painter order: abyss/temple first, signs and columns next, suspended bridge deck/body last so the bridge hides lower column portions.
